products.name: Vay món tiền mặt (lump-sum cash loan)

amountMinVnd.note: Page data: 'Hạn mức cho vay từ 10 triệu đến 100 triệu đồng'.

termMinMonths.note: 'Kỳ hạn vay từ 6 tháng đến 36 tháng'.

minPercent.note: Page text: 'Lãi suất chỉ từ 14.05%/năm'. Floor only. Basis/period: the 06/01/2026 terms define the lending rate as %/year, accrued daily on actual days over 365, on remaining principal of each period, i.e. reducing balance, quoted yearly. The PDF formula text is garbled, so basis is inferred from that clause; the product page itself only says %/nam. The page calculator uses an unexplained default of 25 (%/yr); not recorded as a rate.

maxPercent.note: Maximum rate not published; page says only 'chi tu' (from).

fees.name: Early settlement fee
fees.nameVi: Phí trả nợ trước hạn (tất toán trước hạn)

percentOfPrincipal.note: Terms (effective 06/01/2026), Dieu 2 Muc II: early repayment fee = 5% x outstanding in-term principal at the early-repayment processing date, minimum 1,650,000 VND, or another fee set by Mcredit per period. Percent applies to OUTSTANDING principal at payoff, not original principal. Payable at settlement; full early settlement allowed after at least 4 instalments paid (or other period set by Mcredit). PDF text had broken Vietnamese diacritics; numbers read cleanly.

fixedVnd.note: This is the MINIMUM early settlement fee (applies if 5% of outstanding principal is lower). Same clause.

Terms Dieu 2.3(i) Muc I: 12,000 VND per repayment transaction (incl. VAT) when paying via a collection-agent service. Paid to the collection partner; the terms say it is NOT a fee charged by Mcredit and not part of the monthly loan payment. E-wallet payments follow the wallet provider's own fees. Whether it can be avoided depends on payment channel, so mandatory is null.

insurance.name: Loan-attached insurance (voluntary), premium financed by Mcredit

mandatory.note: Terms Dieu 3 Muc I: applies only where the customer voluntarily registers to buy insurance (tu nguyen). The loan principal then includes the amount borrowed to pay the premium, which Mcredit pays to the insurer. Mcredit is the beneficiary of payouts up to the outstanding debt. Whether a particular offer pushes insurance is not published.

minMonthlyIncomeVnd.note: Not published. The web form asks for income but states no minimum.

researchNotes: 1) data/licensed-institutions.json did not exist when this was written, so the licence check could not be done. Mcredit's footer names it 'Công ty Tài chính tín dụng tiêu dùng TNHH MB Shinsei'; id 'mcredit' must be added to that list with an SBV source. 2) No standalone biểu phí or lãi suất table for cash/installment loans is published. Key sources: the product pages (embedded calculator JSON, last modified 2025-03-19) and the 'Bản Điều khoản Điều kiện cho vay Khách hàng cá nhân không có tài sản bảo đảm' effective 06/01/2026: https://mcredit.com.vn/content/134127651471669734/ban-dieu-khoan-dieu-kien-cho-vay-khach-hang-ca-nhan_mcredit_2025.pdf (text extracted with pdftotext; diacritics partly lost but numbers and formulas readable). 3) Rates: only 'từ 14.05%/năm' (cash) and 'từ 0%/năm' (installment); no maximum or typical rate. The contract formula implies reducing balance, daily accrual over 365 days. The calculator default of 25 is unexplained and not recorded. 4) Contradictions: early repayment 0 VND (app page alt text) vs 5% of outstanding principal, minimum 1,650,000 VND (terms); installment max term 48 (calculator) vs 72 months (headline); cash loan max 36 vs app 72 months. 5) Insurance is voluntary and financed into the loan per the terms; premiums unknown. 6) Age and minimum income not published. 7) No worked example published, so representativeExamples is empty. 8) A 2021 press item (thitruongtaichinhtiente.vn) says Mcredit charged no service fee on installment/cash loans; old and secondary, not used. 9) Mcredit has warned about impersonators collecting advance fees.
